title: Amazingly Charred Chinese Guanciale Kung Pao
description: A charred, creamy, one-pot Chinese dish featuring guanciale and a pasta-water-emulsion, with Mediterranean-friendly flavors, in the style of Kung Pao.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add the guanciale and cook until charred, about 2 minutes per side.
Remove the guanciale from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the wok.
Add the soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, cornstarch, sichuan peppercorns, and red pepper flakes to the wok and stir to combine.
Cook for 1 minute, until the sauce is thickened and bubbly.
Add the chopped scallions and roasted peanuts to the wok and stir to combine.
Add the cooked guanciale back to the wok and stir to combine.
Add the pasta water to the wok and stir to combine, creating a creamy emulsion.
Season with salt to taste, then serve immediately.
